purpose: Pinned shallow clones of reference source used as inspiration by the triplex-db-2 native lanes. Contents are gitignored; re-clone at these SHAs to reproduce.

xtdb.why: pinned engine image ghcr.io/xtdb/xtdb:2.2.0; XTQL/SQL semantics, FOR PORTION OF VALID_TIME, system-time, tests

qlever.why: pinned engine image adfreiburg/qlever:0.6.0; SPARQL eval, vocabulary/collation, update/delta triples

rdf-tests.why: W3C SPARQL 1.1 conformance suite as independent semantic oracle

oxigraph.why: reference SPARQL evaluator semantics (ORDER BY, STR, NOT EXISTS)

sparqljs.why: TS SPARQL parser/generator for a typed builder/validator

ldkit.why: TypeScript RDF ORM: schema->SPARQL entity mapping

drizzle-orm.why: TS ORM ergonomics: typed tables + raw sql escape hatch
